notes: Six bullets, five steps. Bullet 1 is a precondition -- 8 Vanadiel days after His Name is Valgeir -- and not something you do, so it is a note on step 1 and a time_gated flag; nothing in the packets reports it. Bullet 4 is 'obtain X and Y then trade them', and the obtain is deliberately NOT its own rung: it would wedge an unmarkable, zone-less step between two consecutive Valgeir steps, and the trade's items already tell the runtime that holding both means ready to hand in. The indented lines under bullet 5 are one player's timestamped testimonial (07:29 traded, 09:11 received), not instructions. Land crab bisque resolves as a KEY ITEM (id 91) and not as an item, so it is written as ki on both the step that grants it and the step that spends it; it is also not the header's Reward (Tableware Set), so using it as evidence is legal. Fame is blank on a Mhaura quest -- no region is asserted rather than inferring one, and FLevel 4 is kept.

notes: Three bullets, three steps, and the ladder is clean: talk, farm the arrow, trade it at the tower. Frayed Arrow resolves as an ITEM (2462) and not as a key item, so it is the kill step's evidence and the trade step's held requirement -- the one genuine observable in this quest. Bullet 3 says to trade 'to the door' but names the thing Giwahb Watchtower, so that is the target; no 'Door:' form is invented, since the page never writes one. Two conditions have no slot in the schema and gate nothing here. 'Ode to the Serpents must be active' is an ACTIVE quest, not a completed one -- writing it into prev would assert completion, which is the opposite -- and the closing line that the cutscenes only happen while General Najelith is in Al Zahbi is a world state no packet reports. The sub-bullets are Attercop locations (three at the Watchtower, more at F-6 and E-8) and belong to the kill step as a note.

notes: Two bullets, three steps. Bullet 1 both starts the quest and states the objective in its own text -- Yazan 'asks you to exterminate Sand Bats in Valkurm Dunes' -- so the hunt is split out as its own rung in its own zone. Without it the mark sits on Yazan in Port Bastok for the whole middle of the quest, pointing the player at the man they have just left. Bullet 2's 'Once you have one' presupposes exactly that hunt. The sub-bullets say where the fang comes from: Sand Bats in the Valkurm tunnels, or the Auction House. The Auction House is not an items_alt, because it is a different way to get the SAME held item, not a different item that satisfies the step. The After-the-walkthrough Notes section is a Records of Eminence cross-reference and is not a step. Fame 'B' is Bastok.

notes: Bullet 1 names THREE NPCs in a fixed order -- Yuli Yaam, Yung Yaam, then Jatan-Paratan -- and they are deliberately one step, not three. Its sub-bullet says the quest only appears in the log after the answer 'I have no recollection at all' and a second conversation, i.e. after ALL THREE. Since the runtime treats the quest appearing in the log as proof that step 1 is done, three rungs here would leave the mark two behind the player for the rest of the quest. All three stand in the Timbre Timbers tavern at the same (F-10), so the merge costs nothing on the map and the order is kept in the note. Bullet 2 gives Aramu-Paramu no location at all; Windurst Waters is inferred because bullet 3 ('Head to Lower Jeuno') is the first bullet that leaves the city -- that step is marked medium and flagged, and the NPC key is unambiguous so a wrong zone would cost nothing but the place. Windurst Waters (North) and (South) are one zone, 238. The header's 'Rosewood Lbr.' is the short form of Rosewood Lumber; the long name is used.

steps.note: in the Timbre Timbers tavern, Windurst Waters (North). Speak to Yuli Yaam and Yung Yaam FIRST, then Jatan-Paratan; answer "I have no recollection at all", then speak to him once more. Only then is the quest in your log, which is why all three are one step.

notes: Four bullets, five steps: bullet 3 is two things -- 'after defeating Cunning Craklaw, make sure to click the River Mouth' -- so the kill and the second click are separate rungs, exactly the split the guide describes. The River Mouth is clicked TWICE, once to pop the NM and once to take the key item, and those two clicks are the same object in the same place; they are kept apart because the fight genuinely sits between them and the mob is itself a marker target. The Vial of toxic Zoldeff water (ki 2185) is the only observable in the quest and sits on the second click, where it is actually granted. Bullet 2's parenthetical '(The island of the Frontier Station)' is a location gloss, not a second target. The trailing 'See the Talk Page for testimonials' is not a step. Adoulin is not one of the addon's nine fame regions, so no region is asserted and only FLevel 1 and the raw string survive.

notes:
The Lilac ribbon is the interesting bit: the header files it under Item Reqs, but it does not resolve as an item at all -- it is KEY ITEM 855. So it is written as ki both where the ??? grants it and where Fari-Wari needs it held, and a naive 'Item Reqs means item' reading would have lost this quest its only observable. Bullet 2 spans two zones only as routing: the instruction is to examine the ??? at (H-11) in Halvung, and 'go to Wajaom Woodlands (C-8) to enter Halvung' is how you get there, so it stays a note rather than becoming a travel rung -- the same treatment route advice gets elsewhere in the corpus. Bullets 3 and 4 are both Fari-Wari with a game day between them; they stay two rungs because the page really does put a wait there, and being the same NPC they are one marker regardless. The closing line -- cutscenes only while General Rughadjeen is in Al Zahbi, which is also the header's Quest Req -- is a world state no packet reports and gates nothing.

notes: Four bullets, three steps. Bullet 4 -- 'you can also choose to keep the Power Sandals for yourself' -- is a way to FAIL the quest, not a rung; a verb scan would have made a step of it. The Jar is named by the page and is the thing you click, but it roams: ten possible grids are listed, so the step keeps the zone and carries all ten in its note rather than asserting one, which is why grid is null. Power Sandals (13012) are a real item, are not the header's Reward (which is empty), and are granted at the Jar, so they are honest evidence there and the held requirement at Devean. The whole quest is a wager measured in GAME hours -- the faster the return the bigger the payout -- and neither the timer nor the bet is visible to the addon.

notes: Five bullets, three steps, and two of the five bullets are outcomes rather than actions. Bullet 2 ('you will receive [KI] Evil warding seal') is what bullet 1 gives you, so it is step 1's evidence and not a rung of its own -- evidence must be obtained AT the step that grants it. Bullet 4 ('upon touching that you will lose the original key item') is the consequence of bullet 3, so it merges into the same step; the seal is consumed there and nothing is gained, which is why that step has no evidence at all and the ladder falls back on the session latch for the walk home. The ??? at (D-11) of Vunkerl Inlet (S) can never carry a marker, but the zone and grid keep the rung. The header's requirement, [KI] Brass Ribbon of Service, does not resolve against the key-item table and has no slot in the schema in any case, so it is flagged and gates nothing; the FLevel field holds that same string instead of a number, so no fame level is asserted. Crystal War is not one of the nine fame regions.

notes: One bullet, and it is an OR over two places: the Audience Chamber (H-6) in Ru'Lude Gardens, or the Jeuno Bulwark Gate in Sauromugue Champaign (S). The schema has no OR, so the two are modelled as a group -- which formally means 'all of these, in any order' but draws both at once, and drawing both is exactly what an OR wants; flagged so a human can see the compromise. NEITHER step carries evidence, even though the bullet's sub-bullet lists two key items: both appear verbatim in the header's Reward, and a reward proves the quest is over rather than that a step is done. The walkthrough names no NPC at all -- the cutscene fires on arrival, nothing is clicked -- so the targets are the two places the page names rather than the header's 'Voidwatch Officer'. That name resolves but is flagged AMBIGUOUS by the resolver, i.e. it is worn by more than one entity, so start.zone is pinned to Ru'Lude Gardens (the header's own Description says 'the palace in Ru'Lude Gardens') to stop the start marker appearing on every Voidwatch Officer in Vana'diel. Both step targets are places rather than confirmed entities, so the quest is medium: if they do not match live objects the rungs keep their zone and grid and lose only their markers. The sub-bullet is the outcome -- two key items, quest complete, the next quest auto-flagged -- and is not a step.

steps.note: the cutscene starts on arrival; the page names nothing to click, so this is the place rather than an entity the walkthrough confirms. Either this or step 2 -- not both.
